scripts.build: vite build && node --input-type=module -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist/_redirects', { force: true }))"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4.153.0 deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler@4.153.0 d1 migrations apply wadhaya-store-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler@4.153.0 d1 migrations apply wadhaya-store-db --remote
